state.W: schema, empty rows, count, journal_mode, foreign_keys, read_uncommitted, source and action admissibility at pre-treatment
state.E: minimum-next-id threshold m, provided as an environment demand, not hidden mechanism state
state.decision_bit: B = (H+1 < E.m), computed only from prospective pre-action fields

structural_arms.NOOP: No extra write transaction; afterwards submit exactly INSERT INTO events(note) VALUES('next') RETURNING id;
structural_arms.RESERVE: As one committed transaction, INSERT explicit id m-1 into events, then DELETE that row, preserving empty public rows; afterwards submit identical final INSERT oracle

outcome_vector: public rows remain empty after action

pre_declared_hypotheses.optimal_action: RESERVE iff h+1 < m; otherwise NOOP
pre_declared_hypotheses.expected_grid: state-aware policy yields zero violations without redundant repairs; constant NOOP has 5 failing of 8 demand contexts, constant RESERVE has 3 avoidable reservations of 8; each repeated 3x

negative_outcomes: NOOP or RESERVE result violates source semantics
W differs before actions for same (h,m,round)
H is measured after outcome or derived from it
A1 does not preserve visible rows or treatment isolation
all constant policies tie the state-aware policy on lexicographic burden
timing or file size wrongly used as a binding proof
evidence_claim_ceiling: Calibration of state-conditioned action choice and minimal 1-bit decision feature on a fixed SQLite source/action/demand support only. Not independent real-maintenance demand, novel SQLite allocator semantics, source-code architecture superiority, transport, universal state sufficiency or LAW-R2.

governance.GITHUB_ACTIONS: contents read only; no repo commits/pushes/tags
